name: Design and Implement FeedTrack or other feedback tracking tool
description:
# Context

We are creating a shared Docusaurus theme for the Developers' portal. Figma is [here](https://www.figma.com/design/ZmSsc8dVmzloTI8jVFN1ur/Docusaurus?node-id=160-7121&t=h0iszn2LPRqYVW2J-1).

# Task

We want a feedback loop that will provide us with information about what pages are helpful for Developers. Also, track additional text feedback.

[See inspiration.](https://developers.asana.com/docs/overview) 

[https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/953cc55c-45de-47d1-84f2-3c3fbf183a81](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/953cc55c-45de-47d1-84f2-3c3fbf183a81)

- ☑ Consult feedback track tool with @zdns 

- Consulted: In Core Knowledge Base (and also in other channels accross company), we use FeedTrack as a CSAT tool. Current person communicating with FT is Zlata Vavrušková. FT's pricing depends on the required survey and its design. For an inquiry, please contact Zlatka.  

- ☐ Consult design with @hudak-filip 
- ☐ Implement a feedback component
